LOOK_AT.say: A man in his fifties in a clean apron, doing something careful with a plane. He has not looked up.
repeat: His hands are a carpenter's. Everything else about him is a clerk's.
He is the only man in Consolation who is not waiting for something.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. He works quietly and he does not hum.
repeat: Breathing, and a plane on pine. It is the most restful sound in the territory and I would rather it were anywhere else.

options.text: I'm looking for a man named Ezra Pike.

exchange.speaker: undertaker
exchange.line: Eighteen fifty-two. He's up the hill.

options.say: Boot Hill. Third row, second from the end. He's got a marker.

options.text: I had a letter for him.
options.say: You still have a letter for him.
